status: model-free G0 only; no v20 Astra score
native_claim: Native F8 v1 supplies the recovery incident and immutable recovery-point evidence only.
authored_claim: Both losing-branch writes, write-bound acknowledgment receipts, customer operation identity, application actions, queued orders and shipments, and business scores are authored or simulator-derived.
matched_difference: The losing branch has the same two write IDs, order IDs, payloads and entry order. The receipt-bound operation identity assigns one write as a retry of the fixed serving operation and the other as a distinct acknowledgment, with that assignment reversed across twins. The opaque independent ID is rekeyed across twins to defeat lexical ordering; receipt IDs and immutable losing-log hashes derive from identity.
service_limit: Raw replay deduplicates by branch-local write ID only. Orders and shipments stay queued without external dispatch during reconciliation, so verified duplicates can be compensated. A real global operation-key dedup service would collapse the replay hazard.
